messages.subject: Energy Absolute | Clean energy growth, stakeholder trust and execution
messages.body:
Dear Energy Absolute Leadership Team,

Energy Absolute's clean-energy platform is closely aligned with the transition work I support today from within a large industrial operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities include government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

A central part of my recent work has involved stakeholder and governance support around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage. I also coordinated carbon-data readiness using physical operating records and lead multi-agency engagement on environmental and operating matters. I understand the institutional work required to move clean-energy investment from plan to execution.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across External Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or country strategy. I have attached an Energy Absolute-focused executive CV and would appreciate your sharing it with the relevant senior leadership team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
